rules: An illegal-instruction exception is raised when attempting to execute a vector instruction if the mstatus.VS field is set to Off.
An illegal-instruction exception is raised when attempting to execute a vector instruction if the vtype.vill bit is set.
Vector instructions begin execution with the element number specified in the vstart register.
All vector instructions reset the vstart register to zero upon completion.
The read-only CSR vlenb holds the value VLEN/8, where VLEN is the vector register length in bytes.
Executing a vector instruction causes the mstatus.VS field to change to Dirty if mstatus.VS was set to Initial or Clean.
If the hypervisor extension is present and V=1, executing any vector instruction or accessing vector CSRs causes both mstatus.VS and vsstatus.VS to change to Dirty if neither is set to Off.
If the hypervisor extension is present and V=1, executing a state-changing vector instruction causes vsstatus.VS to change to Dirty if neither is set to Off.
The vxrm register specifies the fixed-point rounding mode used for fixed-point operations.
The vxsat register indicates if a fixed-point instruction had to saturate an output value.
